tomContent.summary: Overnight markets signal a positive open with tech futures up 0.4-0.5% following Monday's tech bounce. Key headlines include Thrive Capital's record $10B fundraise, Netflix extending Paramount deal talks, and JPMorgan calling the software selloff overdone amidst continued hyperscaler AI capex. Consumer weakness emerges with General Mills slashing guidance, while economic strain persists with 62% of young workers tapping retirement savings due to inflation.
